label: <DEL> step of long (L>=8) sequences whose first token is 2
explanation: Fires almost exclusively (99% of mass) at the delimiter step, i.e. the step where the model must output original token 0, and only in long sequences (L=9: 74% of mass, L=8: 25%, L=7 trace, never L<=6). Strongly selective for the token about to be recalled (first original token): 2 accounts for 82% of mass (rate 3.9% vs 0.1% baseline); o, k, t, g, 3, p give weaker activations. Magnitude is highest for L=9 with first token 2 (top examples all 2 ... <DEL> at step 9, ~0.9-1.0 of max); L=8 with first token 2 is weaker and often silent (most false positives). Weak low-quartile activations occur at the L=9 delimiter for other first tokens. Small trace on the last original input (step L-1) just before <DEL>. Never fires during the copy phase or on early original tokens.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=2 (+4.78), phase=1 & out_tok=o (+4.00), orig1=q (+3.24), orig2=q (+3.03), phase=1 & out_tok=k (+2.99), phase=1 & out_tok=2 (+2.81). Lower it: orig7=- (-5.73), phase=2 (-4.41), next_out=- (-4.08), orig6=- (-3.66).
